title: BHMS protocol 2026-11-13
description: Normative JSON Schema for BHMS v0.1 (spec/bhms). A message that fails this schema is a bug in its sender.

bhms_find.description: Find devices (and saved programs) by text, capability, tag or status; with no arguments it lists every device. Start here.

bhms_describe.description: Describe one device: its actions with argument units and bounds, properties, effects, lease and stop behaviour.

bhms_read.description: Read a device property. The result says how the value was obtained (measured, reported, commanded...), its quality and age.

bhms_invoke.description: Invoke a device action and wait up to wait_ms for the outcome. Pass operation_key when you may retry; after a timeout call bhms_operation, or repeat this call with the SAME operation_key and identical arguments: it returns the original operation instead of acting twice.

bhms_operation.description: Get an operation's current state, or wait up to wait_ms for it to settle. Use this instead of re-invoking.

bhms_cancel.description: Ask one operation to stop. Cancellation is a request: check the returned cancel.state. Use bhms_stop to halt a device.

bhms_stop.description: Stop devices now: runs their stop procedure, ends their operations and revokes their leases. The safe action when something goes wrong. Not an emergency stop.

bhms_run_program.description: Run a bounded program (inline or by program_digest from bhms_find) as one operation. The whole program is validated before any step runs.

Time.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.

ClientOperationKey.description: Idempotency key sent by a client; the d- prefix is reserved for derived keys (BHMS-OPS-037).

AgentOperationKey.description: Idempotency key chosen by a model; d- and g- prefixes are reserved (BHMS-OPS-037).

NumericUnitRule.description: A schema whose type is number or integer must carry x-bhms-unit (BHMS-DEV-041).

ExtensionKey.description: Extension identifier: reverse-DNS prefix, '/', name; the bhms/ prefix is reserved.

Extensions.description: Map of extension identifiers to settings objects.

JsonSchema.description: An embedded JSON Schema 2020-12 document (x-bhms-unit on physical numbers).

ObjectSchema.description: A closed object JSON Schema (type object, additionalProperties false).

Implementation.description: Software identity; display and logging only.

ClientCapabilities.description: Capabilities a client declares per request.

ResultType.description: Result kind; only 'complete' in this version.

SubscriptionMeta.description: Metadata of a notification delivered on a subscription.

NotificationMeta.description: Metadata of a notification outside a subscription.

ErrorData.description: data of a BHMS error response.

field.description: Path of the offending member from params.

bound.description: The violated bound, expected value or supported set.

mayHaveActed.description: Whether a device may have acted because of the request.

OperationError.description: Error recorded in an operation, a DeviceStop or an agent refusal.

field.description: Path of the offending member from params.

bound.description: The violated bound, expected value or supported set.

mayHaveActed.description: Whether a device may have acted because of the request.

ErrorObject.description: JSON-RPC error object. BHMS codes carry ErrorData whose bhmsCode matches the number; DEVICE_FAULT and UNVERIFIED occur only inside operations (BHMS-ERR-012).

ProgramLimits.description: Program limits (08-programs.md 8.1); servers may advertise lower values only.

authority.description: The server serves several principals or enforces a scope policy (conformance profile authority); absent means single-principal. Carries no members: a caller learns nothing about the principals.

Limits.description: Hard limits applied to every request.

Principal.description: The authenticated principal and its effective scopes.

epoch.description: Identity of the server's durable state.

EffectClass.description: Physical effect class of an action.

EvidenceKind.description: How an observed value was obtained.

DeviceSummary.description: Compact device summary for lists (<= 400 tokens).

capability.description: Exact id, a prefix ending in .*, or * for any capability

text.description: Words separated by whitespace; a device matches when any word occurs, ignoring case, in its id, name, summary, tags or capabilities.

DeviceDescription.description: Immutable device description; digest covers everything except digest.

Observation.description: Immutable record of a property value and how it was known.

value.description: Value, null when quality is invalid or unknown.

OperatorMark.description: Marks a reconciliation entry written by operations/resolve from an operator's statement, not from device evidence (BHMS-OPS-102).

OperationUpstream.description: Where a gateway forwarded the operation: shown to admin principals only (7.6).

server.description: The gateway's name for the upstream server (the namespace prefix of its device ids).

operationId.description: The operation id on that server.

Operation.description: Durable record of one physical intent (06-operations.md).

arguments.description: Arguments exactly as sent (the requestDigest input).

admittedArguments.description: Arguments as admitted (defaults applied, quantity objects replaced by values); present only when they differ from arguments.

replayed.description: True when an existing operation was returned.

OperatorResolution.description: An operator's resolution of an unknown operation, with the basis it rests on (6.10). An operator's statement is a report: it never yields effect verified or measured evidence.

basis.description: Free text: what was inspected, by whom, and what was found.

effect.description: completed: unverified (none for an action without effect), the default. failed: unknown by default; unverified; or none together with mayHaveActed false.

mayHaveActed.description: failed only; false claims proof that nothing happened and goes with effect none.

result.description: completed only: the result, valid against the action's output.

cancelRequestedOperations.description: Operations in flight or unknown whose cancellation was requested; not yet canceled.

endReason.description: Why the server ended the subscription.

Step.description: One program step, discriminated by kind.

ProgramInfo.description: Validated program summary; a tool definition.

text.description: Words; a device matches when any word occurs in its id, name, summary, tags or capabilities.

capability.description: Capability id, a prefix ending in .*, or * for any

topic.description: A guide instead of a device: program-grammar is the bhms_run_program format.

arguments.description: Arguments per the action's input schema; numbers in the declared unit, or {value, unit}.

operation_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same key with identical arguments to retry safely.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000).

require_verified.description: Fail unless the effect is verified by measurement.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000).

operation_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same key with identical arguments to retry safely.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000).

totalDevices.description: Present when no device matched: how many devices an unfiltered bhms_find lists (its first page when there are more).

AgentTopicData.description: Structured content of bhms_describe with topic: a guide as text.

AgentDescribeData.description: Structured content of bhms_describe: a device description, or a guide when topic was given.

AgentFunctionResult.description: Result of a function-tool call: summary plus data or error.

signature.description: bhms_describe only: the compact signature block of BHMS-AGT-013, or the guide text of a topic (function tools cannot carry it after the one-line summary).
